readingPassage.title: Bird Migration: The Science of Seasonal Journeys (A 类学术·2026-08-15 真题话题)
readingPassage.text:
Bird migration is one of the most remarkable phenomena in the natural world. Every year, billions of birds travel thousands of kilometres between their breeding grounds and wintering sites, guided by an internal compass that remains only partly understood. Young birds attempting their first journey must rely on innate programming rather than the experience of elders, which makes the initial migration especially hazardous.

Navigation depends on several cues. Many species use the position of the sun by day and the stars by night, while others detect the Earth's magnetic field through specialised cells. Seasonal changes in day length trigger the urge to move, and favourable winds are exploited whenever they appear. Birds that migrate at night often fly beneath a clear, visible sky so that celestial landmarks remain available throughout the journey.

Survival during migration is far from guaranteed. Predators such as hawks and falcons patrol busy migration corridors, and exhaustion leaves stragglers vulnerable. Parental investment is greatest before departure, when adults fatten chicks for the demands ahead, yet once the young fledge they receive no further guidance. Those that become separated from their flock are easily lost, and many never complete the return trip. Conservationists argue that protecting stopover habitats is therefore as vital as safeguarding the destinations themselves.

qs.q: What primarily guides young birds on their first migration?
qs.loc: rely on innate programming rather than the experience of elders
qs.para: first journey ↔ innate programming；rather than experience of elders。
qs.trap: 题干问 young birds first journey，对应 innate programming，而非 elders 的经验。

qs.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a navigation cue?
qs.loc: use the position of the sun ... detect the Earth's magnetic field
qs.para: 文中明确提到 sun 与 magnetic field，未提及 ocean currents。
qs.trap: C 为无中生有，属典型 NOT given 干扰。

qs.q: At night, birds prefer a clear, ______ sky to keep celestial landmarks available.
qs.trap: visible 拼写注意 -ible 结尾。

qs.q: ______ such as hawks and falcons threaten migrating birds along busy corridors.
qs.loc: Predators such as hawks and falcons patrol
qs.para: predators ↔ 题干；hawks and falcons 为举例。

qs.q: Before departure, adults provide ______ investment by fattening chicks.
qs.loc: Parental investment is greatest before departure
qs.trap: parental 拼写（parent + al），易误写为 parent。

qs.q: Young birds that separate from the flock are easily ______.
qs.loc: Those that become separated from their flock are easily lost
qs.para: separated ↔ 题干；easily lost 原词复现。
qs.trap: lost 为过去分词，注意 t 结尾。

listeningSets.title: Section 1 · 生活场景（度假小屋预订）
listeningSets.transcript: Hello, you've reached Lakeside Holidays. My name's Sarah, how can I help? — Hi, I'd like to book a cottage for the weekend of the 14th of September. — Certainly. We have the Willow Cottage, which sleeps four, at 120 pounds per night, and the larger Oak Cottage at 180 pounds per night. Both include heating and parking. — Does the price include breakfast? — No, breakfast isn't included, but there's a cafe next door that opens at 8 a.m. Check-in is from 3 p.m. and check-out is by 10 a.m. — Great. And is it pet-friendly? — Yes, but there's a 15-pound cleaning fee for pets. We also ask for a 50-pound deposit when you book. — Perfect, I'll take the Oak Cottage.

qs.q: The booking is for the weekend of the ______ of September.
qs.trap: 序数词 14th 拼写易错，注意 th。

qs.q: Price of the Oak Cottage: ______ pounds per night.
qs.loc: Oak Cottage at 180 pounds per night

qs.trap: 区分 check-in 3 p.m. 与 check-out 10 a.m.。
区分 15 清洁费 与 50 押金。

qs.q: Breakfast is included in the cottage price.

listeningSets.title: Section 3 · 学术场景（生态小组作业讨论）
listeningSets.transcript: Right, so for our ecology presentation we need to cover three case studies. I think we should start with the bee population decline in Europe — the data from 2019 to 2023 shows a 30% drop. — Okay. And the second one could be coral bleaching on the Great Barrier Reef. The professor said we must mention the role of rising sea temperatures. — Good. For the third, how about urban heat islands? A study in our city found summer temperatures were 4 degrees higher in the centre than in the suburbs. — That works. We've got 15 minutes total, so about 5 minutes each. Don't forget we need at least two references per case study. — Agreed. I'll handle the first two and you take the third. We'll meet on Thursday at 2 p.m. to rehearse.

qs.q: Bee population in Europe dropped by ______ % between 2019 and 2023.
qs.trap: 百分比 30，注意与年份区分。

qs.q: The second case study is about coral ______ on the Great Barrier Reef.
qs.loc: coral bleaching on the Great Barrier Reef

qs.q: Urban centre temperatures were ______ degrees higher than suburbs.
qs.loc: 4 degrees higher in the centre than in the suburbs
qs.trap: 数字 4 度，注意与 2 p.m. 混淆。

qs.q: How long is the total presentation?
The two students will rehearse on Thursday at 2 p.m.
qs.loc: meet on Thursday at 2 p.m. to rehearse

part1.q: Do you use social media often? What do you usually use it for, and do you try to limit your screen time?
part1.tip: Band 7+ 思路：给具体 App 与频率（Instagram/WhatsApp），并用对比结构说明限制习惯，别说只会 very useful。

part1.q: What is your favourite piece of technology? Why is it so important in your daily life?
part1.tip: 用具体功能展开（导航/学习/支付），体现 user-friendly、convenient 等词汇，避免泛泛而谈。

part1.q: How do you usually get your news — newspapers, TV, or social media? Has this changed over the years?
part1.tip: 对比过去（报纸/电视）与现在（社媒），使用现在完成时与过去时体现变化。

part2.topic: Describe an app you use often（验证 2026 当季卡）
bullets: how long you have used it
part2.tip: 讲具体习惯 + 一个改变 + 明确好处，用故事化展开撑满 2 分钟，切忌只罗列功能。

part2.topic: Describe a TV programme or film you enjoyed recently（高频）
part2.tip: 开头点题，用感官与细节描写（画面/叙事），结尾点明感动或启发。

part2.topic: Describe a teacher who influenced you（高频）
part2.tip: 用具体事例 + 一句引言，结尾点明对学习的长远影响。

part3.q: Why do so many people find it hard to put their phones down?
part3.tip: 从即时反馈/多巴胺、社交焦虑、工作随时在线三个角度展开。

part3.q: Do smartphone apps make our lives easier or more complicated?
part3.tip: 辩证：便利（支付/导航）vs 信息过载与依赖，给出个人倾向并举例。

part3.q: How has social media changed the way people communicate?
part3.tip: 双刃剑：连接更方便 vs 深度对话减少、表情符号替代语气。

dailyDialogue.q: How has technology changed the way you keep in touch with friends?
dailyDialogue.tip: 用 now... whereas before... 对比，体现时态。

dailyDialogue.q: Do you think people rely too much on apps these days? Why or why not?
dailyDialogue.tip: 用 crutch / over-reliance 等词，给一个具体例子。

dailyDialogue.q: What kinds of apps are most popular among young people where you live?
dailyDialogue.tip: 按 entertainment / communication / education 分类作答。

dailySentence: Although bird migration is driven by innate programming, the survival of fledglings depends heavily on favourable weather and the absence of predators along the route.
While economic growth creates jobs and tax revenue, its long-term viability rests on ecosystems that environmental degradation threatens to undermine.
Not only does self-employment offer autonomy and uncapped income, but it also exposes workers to irregular earnings and the absence of an institutional safety net.

task2.prompt: Some people think that economic development should be the most important goal of governments, while others argue that protecting the natural world is more important. Discuss both views and give your opinion. （真实考题，reported 2026-08-08，simplyielts 验证）
task2.outline: Intro：改写题目 + 立场（nature first，但承认经济重要）。Body1：经济发展创造就业与税收，穷国常需资源开发。Body2：环境是经济的基础，破坏不可逆，且绿色产业也能创造就业。Conclusion：可持续 = 以环境为底，而非二选一。

task2.prompt: In many countries, more and more people are choosing to work for themselves rather than for an employer. What are the reasons for this trend? Do the advantages of self-employment outweigh the disadvantages? （真实考题，reported 2026-08，simplyielts 验证）
task2.outline: Intro：点明原因并给出 outweigh 立场（利大于弊）。Body1：原因——平台降低门槛、远程工作改变预期、对企业忠诚下降。Body2：利（自主/收入无上限/技能可见）vs 弊（收入不稳/无保障/孤独，但可控）。Conclusion：重申利大于弊，弊端可通过规划缓解。

task1.prompt: The table shows the amount of electricity generated from five different energy sources in the UK in three different years. Summarise the main features and make comparisons where relevant. （真实 Task 1，2026-08-15 真题回忆）
task1.outline: 开头总述表含 5 种能源、3 个年份与英国背景；主体按总量趋势（如 nuclear / wind 上升、coal 下降）分组对比，指出最大与最小来源；结尾概括结构性变化。
